paginate_goldens.cursor_protocol: 'per_page:page:index' via PaginateCursor(size, page, offset); ABSENT cursor -> PaginateCursor(1000,0,0); malformed -> ValueError('Invalid cursor format: ...') -> 500 (no handler catches it in version.py!)
paginate_goldens.max_limit: PAGINATOR_MAX_LIMIT=1000; page_size=min(cursor.size,1000); total_pages=ceil(total/page_size) — ZeroDivision when total=0? ceil(0/size)=0, no division by zero (size>=1 unless cursor '0:x:0' -> min(0,1000)=0 -> ZeroDivisionError -> 500. RECORDED EDGE.
